definition_of_ready: scope is one coherent security behavior
title: Confine generated outputs and CI evidence to repository boundaries
goal: Prevent caller-controlled generated outputs and adaptive CI evidence from escaping the repository root while preserving cross-platform deterministic behavior.
inputs: redacted gosec finding evidence from push/PR
repository root and canonical path invariants
outputs: workspace-local adaptive change evidence with automatic cleanup
invariants: caller-controlled output paths cannot escape repository root
repository reads do not follow symlinks across the trust boundary
no SAST finding is suppressed before its sink is reviewed
security_properties: fail closed on relative or absolute path escape
generated output parents cannot traverse repository symlinks
temporary CI evidence remains inside the checked-out workspace
acceptance_tests: path tests reject relative and absolute escapes
adaptive engineering-kernel can create and consume workspace-local change evidence on push and PR
definition_of_done: all CLI-controlled generated outputs used by engineering checks are repository-confined
workflow temporary change evidence is repository-confined and cleaned up
